subject: Call for George Scarpelli Resignation
overview: Host Joe Viglione called for the resignation of City Councilor George Scarpelli following a report regarding an incident involving students during a trip where the councilor served as a chaperone. The broadcast also critiqued city management, tax rates, and the lack of a public access television station.

items.title: Report on Boston Globe Article and Mayoral Rumors
items.summary: Joe Viglione discussed a Boston Globe report concerning City Councilor George Scarpelli and addressed rumors regarding a potential mayoral campaign.

items.title: Demand for George Scarpelli’s Resignation
items.summary: Viglione called for Councilor Scarpelli to resign, alleging the councilor was negligent while serving as a chaperone during a student trip where hazing and assault reportedly occurred.

items.title: Critique of Municipal Management and Public Access
items.summary: The speaker criticized high local taxes and water rates, as well as the administration's failure to maintain a functional public access television station.

items.title: Evaluation of Local Media and Official Accountability
items.summary: Viglione addressed the lack of responsiveness from city officials and characterized local news outlets as insufficient for public oversight.
